_comment: eval_cases.json — atlas intent→capability eval cases (AT-2). Created 2026-07-02. Updated 2026-07-03: re-baselined against the full compiled model (237 entries: widgets, skills, connectors, senses — was the 31-entry hand seed) + the fixpoint stemmer; three cases re-pointed at genuinely better specific answers (see their note fields), the fabric stemming xfail promoted to a pass, and four new cases added covering the new kinds (widget, skill, connector, sense). Updated 2026-07-05 (fix/atlas-data-accuracy-and-relevance): nine cases added pinning the data-accuracy + relevance fixes — the /settings/billing, /deep-work, and /security surfaces (new/repointed authored entries), the 'user' member-card vocabulary, the IDF name-weight damper that stops a destructive card ranking first, the five new instruction-filler stopwords, and the orientation query. Each case maps a REAL user intent to the expected top-hit atlas entry id. rank_within: 1 = expected id must be the top result (strict hit), 3 = must appear in the top 3. xfail (optional string): a known ranking miss kept on purpose — never delete a case to go green; the reason documents the weakness for the ranking-upgrade task. note (optional string): reasoning for a re-pointed expectation or measured behavior. Consumed by tests/atlas/test_eval.py.

cases.intent: build me an app to track tasks
I want a human to approve what the agent does
publish this as a website
remember this across sessions
connect my gmail
show this data as a chart
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: was primitive:ripple (rank 4 in the full model). widget:chart is the better answer — the user asks for a chart, and the chart widget IS the concrete capability; ripple is the rendering engine underneath it.

cases.intent: review the agent's edit before it goes live
run this long job in the background
who are our competitors linked to
cases.note: 2026-07-03: xfail promoted — the fixpoint stemmer now maps 'competitors'→'competitor' and 'linked'→'link', so fabric ranks 1. Kept rank_within 3 as originally authored; the strict-hit baseline locks the rank-1 gain.

cases.intent: let the AI write the code and I just review diffs
give my agent a personality that persists
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: soul had slipped to rank 2 behind surface:agents — 'persists' stems to 'persist' which missed the 'persistent' keyword. Fixed as a vocabulary gap: added 'persist' to the authored soul keywords.

cases.intent: sync my google calendar into the workspace
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: was primitive:connector (now rank 2). The compiled model carries per-connector entries and connector:gcalendar is the better answer for a google-calendar-specific intent than the generic connector primitive.

cases.intent: roll back the site to the previous version
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: branch had slipped to rank 2 behind the site skills — the authored keyword was 'rollback' (one word) while users say 'roll back'. Fixed as a vocabulary gap: added 'roll back' to the authored branch keywords.

cases.intent: make a landing page for my bakery
import all these records every night on a schedule
map our customers and their relationships as a graph
fix this bug in the code and propose the change
build a kanban board for my team
cases.note: 2026-07-03 re-baseline: was primitive:pocket (now rank 2). widget:kanban is the better answer — the user names the exact widget; the pocket is the container it lands in.

cases.intent: let users upload a file in the form
cases.note: Added 2026-07-03: widget-kind coverage for the full-model re-baseline.

cases.intent: make a video from this description
cases.note: Added 2026-07-03: skill-kind coverage for the full-model re-baseline.

cases.intent: search our slack messages for the incident
cases.note: Added 2026-07-03: connector-action coverage for the full-model re-baseline.

cases.intent: read our payment and billing data
cases.note: Added 2026-07-03: sense-flavored coverage for the full-model re-baseline — the payments sense outranks connector:stripe for the provider-agnostic phrasing.

cases.intent: change my plan and top up my wallet
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: pins the new /settings/billing surface (data-accuracy fix #1). Before, atlas had no billing surface and workspace-admin falsely claimed there was no billing route; the agent misdirected users to /settings/workspace.

cases.intent: review approvals in deep work
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: pins the repointed operator surface (data-accuracy fix #2). The id stays surface:mission-control but now names 'Deep Work', routes to /deep-work (was the stale /mission-control 308-redirect), and carries approvals/tray vocabulary.

cases.intent: paw-shield security console
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: pins the new owner-gated /security surface (data-accuracy fix #3). paw-shield had no atlas entry at all; the entry carries a role:owner marker so the overlay hides it fail-closed from non-owners.

cases.intent: remove a user
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: relevance fix #5 — the member cards spoke only 'member', so 'user' phrasing missed. Added 'user' synonyms to members_list / member_update_role / member_remove.

cases.intent: delete a user
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: relevance fix #6 — before, the irreversible 'Delete the workspace' card ranked first for this benign intent (its name literally contains 'delete'). The 'user' keyword on member_remove now scores it a full keyword pair, and the IDF name-weight damper keeps generic name hits from dominating; member_remove ranks first, the destructive card no longer above it.

cases.intent: manage workspace users
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: relevance fix #7 — 'workspace' hits 8 entry names, so this was an 8-way tie broken by seed order. The IDF name-weight damper plus discriminating keywords ('manage users','manage members','team management') on members_list break the tie toward the read card.

cases.intent: set up memory
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: relevance fix #9 — 'set' hit the approval-level card's name and 'up' hit widget:follow-up, both at name weight, burying soul. 'up','set','get','open','show' are now instruction-filler stopwords, so only 'memory' scores and soul wins.

cases.intent: disconnect gmail
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: relevance fix #10 — the disable-connector action buried at #3 behind skill:gmail and connector:gmail. Added provider-action disconnect keywords; kept rank_within 3 (the action legitimately shares the query with the provider surfaces) though it now measures rank 1.

cases.intent: what are your capabilities
cases.note: Added 2026-07-05: relevance fix #8 — the most common orientation question had no useful landing. Added 'what can you do','help','get started','capabilities','overview' to surface:home. Content-word orientation phrasings now land home first; the bare 'what can you do' still ties the interrogative-'what' surfaces (activity/audit/foresight) and is a known keyword-vocabulary limit, not pinned here.
